whatThisPluginAdds.text: Referers adds privacy-preserving aggregate referral reporting to Capell. It keeps daily and lifetime counters for finite source keys without storing raw URLs or request identifiers.

surfaceOutcome.text: Administrators review site-scoped referral counts in a cached Referrers report and a small dashboard widget, while origin frontend renders record successful HTML responses best-effort.

developers.text: Typed Actions, bounded validation, atomic upserts, and focused tests keep the privacy contract explicit at each boundary.

teams.text: Site teams can see which configured external sources contribute successful page requests without receiving a browsing-event log.
